scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @finora/api typecheck && pnpm --filter nextjs typecheck && pnpm --filter finora-mobile typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @finora/api test && pnpm --filter nextjs test && pnpm --filter finora-mobile test
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @finora/contracts build && pnpm --filter @finora/domain build && pnpm --filter @finora/api build && pnpm --filter nextjs build
scripts.build:api: pnpm --filter @finora/contracts build && pnpm --filter @finora/domain build && pnpm --filter @finora/api build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter nextjs lint && pnpm --filter finora-mobile lint
scripts.audit:production: pnpm --filter @finora/api audit --prod --audit-level high && pnpm --filter nextjs audit --prod --audit-level high && pnpm --filter finora-mobile audit --prod --audit-level high
